title: The Hubble Tension as Regime Mismatch: Background Gravity vs Structure Gravity in Energy-Flow Cosmology
description: Proposes that the Hubble tension is an environmental regime mismatch: early-universe background probes (CMB/BAO) measure G0, while late-universe distance-ladder probes inside collapsed structures measure Geff = G0 exp(aG·ΔΦ) > G0. Using the Friedmann scaling, the model predicts ln(Hstructure/Hbackground) = 0.5 aG ΔΦ, yielding a ratio 1.083 and H0,structure = 73.0 km/s/Mpc from H0,background = 67.4, without invoking a global time variation of G.

regime_dependent_G.description: Environment-effective gravitational coupling: the smooth background follows G0, while collapsed, entropy-producing structures experience an enhanced coupling Geff.

friedmann_scaling.description: Friedmann relation indicating that, at fixed energy density, changes in the effective coupling map into changes in the Hubble rate.

log_slope_relation.description: From H^2 ∝ G, a fractional change in H is half the fractional change in G; used to connect Geff to the inferred H0.

h0_ratio_prediction.description: Key quantitative prediction of the model linking the background-to-structure H0 offset to the entropy-phase ΔΦ and coupling slope aG.

key_results.main_finding: Interpreting the Hubble tension as a regime mismatch yields Hstructure/Hbackground = exp(0.5 aG ΔΦ) = 1.083, predicting H0,structure = 73.0 km/s/Mpc from 67.4 km/s/Mpc with aG ≈ 0.094 and ΔΦ ≈ 1.71.

sealed_predictions.statement: The ratio of Hubble constants inferred by structure vs background probes is fixed by ln(Hstructure/Hbackground) = 0.5 aG ΔΦ; numerically Hstructure/Hbackground = 1.083 and H0,structure = 73.0 km/s/Mpc given H0,background = 67.4.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Improved background-only (CMB+BAO) and structure-only (distance-ladder inside galaxies) measurements that yield a ratio inconsistent with 1.083 by >3σ after systematics control.

sealed_predictions.statement: Standardized SN Ia absolute magnitudes exhibit an environment-dependent residual of ΔM ≈ 0.02 mag between high-density (cluster) and low-density (void) hosts.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Environment-split Hubble diagram of SNe Ia controlling for host mass, metallicity, and selection effects; failure to detect ΔM at the ≈0.02 mag level falsifies.

sealed_predictions.statement: All background probes cluster near H0 ≈ 67 km/s/Mpc while structure probes cluster near H0 ≈ 73 km/s/Mpc, with mixed probes lying in between.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Meta-analysis that, after reclassification by environment, fails to show a bimodal split consistent with 67 vs 73 km/s/Mpc.

sealed_predictions.statement: Galaxy rotation-curve fits with Geff = G0 exp(aG ΔΦ) recover aG ≈ 0.10 ± 0.02 across SPARC-like samples.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Global fits to SPARC rotation curves preferring aG far from 0.1 (e.g., |aG − 0.1| > 0.06) or consistent with aG = 0.

kill_criteria: KC1: After controlling for host mass, metallicity, and selection, SN Ia standardized magnitudes show no environment-dependent residual at the predicted level (|ΔM| < 0.01–0.02 mag between void and cluster hosts).
KC2: A background-only synthesis (CMB+BAO) yields H0 ≥ 70 km/s/Mpc or a structure-only synthesis (SNe Ia/Cepheids/TRGB/masers) yields H0 ≤ 69 km/s/Mpc at 1σ, eliminating the regime split.
KC3: SPARC or equivalent rotation-curve fits to Geff = G0 exp(aG ΔΦ) exclude aG ≈ 0.1 by >5σ or prefer aG = 0.
KC4: A combined probe classification by environment fails to produce the predicted bimodality (∼67 vs ∼73 km/s/Mpc) in H0 in a large, bias-corrected sample.
epistemic_status: Regime-reinterpretation hypothesis, not yet independent measurement
abstract: Proposes that the Hubble tension arises from regime mismatch: early-universe probes measure background gravity G₀, while late-universe probes operate in structure-dominated environments with G_eff ≠ G₀. Predicts H₀_structure = 73 km/s/Mpc exactly.
key_insight: The distinction between background and structure is not purely temporal but environmental

key_equations.regime_dependent_G: G_eff(R) = G₀ for background, G₀ exp(a_G · ΔΦ) for structure

falsification_criteria: Environment dependence: SNe in voids should give lower H₀ than SNe in clusters
Standard candle systematics: SN Ia magnitude residuals ΔM ~ 0.02 mag by environment
Probe consistency: All background probes → ~67; all structure probes → ~73
a_G from SPARC: Direct fitting must yield a_G ≈ 0.1 ± 0.02
fail_condition: If SN Ia residuals show NO environmental dependence at ΔM ~ 0.02 mag level
